title: Ananthan Kaadu
overview: This is a tale, which almost became a true story. It unfolds in the late Eighties and early Nineties, when the country was going through a dark phase both politically and socially a time when turmoil was writ all over the political scape of the nation.

songs.title: Ponnin Katta (From "Ananthan Kaadu")
songs.singers: P. Bhaskaran, B. Ajaneesh Loknath, K. Raghavan, P. Jayachandran, K.J. Yesudas
